title: Apple Totem
description: mod add enchanted golden Apple totems
body: The apple totem allows you to save a player from death using several really positive effects such as fire resistance or regeneration. The totem has 8 uses and a cooldown but will protect us from practically any death. It features a nice animation and sound and is the perfect successor to the regular Minecraft totem. It also has its own recipe; to craft it, you need a regular totem and other items, to use the totem, hold down the RMB button and then release it.
